name: RankOps AI SEO Publisher
author: rankopsai

sections.description:
RankOps AI SEO Publisher connects WordPress to RankOps AI, an SEO content publishing workflow for planning, generating, reviewing, and sending articles to your own site.

Use this plugin when you want RankOps AI to send approved articles into WordPress without manual copy-paste. WordPress remains the place where you inspect posts, edit content, choose authors, and manage categories and tags.

The plugin focuses on trusted onboarding for site owners who discover RankOps AI from the WordPress Plugin Directory:

  • Clear setup page inside WordPress.
  • Publish URL and Security key generated in the WordPress admin.
  • One-click copy buttons for connection values.
  • Native WordPress Posts, categories, tags, excerpts, and authors.
  • Recent activity log without storing security keys or full article bodies.
  • Duplicate protection for repeated article sends.

Requires a RankOps AI account. Create one at https://rankopsai.com/sign-up. RankOps AI may include free usage, trials, or paid subscriptions depending on your account plan.

Terms of Service: https://rankopsai.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://rankopsai.com/privacy-policy

This plugin does not generate articles inside WordPress. Keyword research, article generation, review, usage limits, and subscription management happen in RankOps AI. The plugin only receives articles that you send from RankOps AI.

This plugin does not inject public credit links, badges, footer links, or backlinks into your website content.

Privacy

This plugin receives article data from RankOps AI when you configure RankOps AI to publish to this WordPress site. It stores the generated Security key as a password hash in WordPress options and never displays the full key again after generation.

The plugin does not send visitor analytics, comments, form submissions, or customer data from WordPress to RankOps AI. It does not add tracking scripts or public external links.

RankOps AI is an external service used to create, review, and send SEO articles. Service website: https://rankopsai.com.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin in WordPress.
  2. Open the RankOps AI menu in the WordPress sidebar.
  3. Create or open your RankOps AI account at https://rankopsai.com.
  4. Copy the Publish URL from WordPress.
  5. Generate a Security key in WordPress and copy it now.
  6. In RankOps AI, add your WordPress site, paste both values, and click Test connection.
  7. Send one approved article first and review it in WordPress Posts.
sections.faq:
Do I need a RankOps AI account?

Yes. RankOps AI plans, creates, reviews, and sends SEO articles. This plugin receives approved articles in WordPress.

Is the plugin free?

Yes. The WordPress plugin is free. RankOps AI article generation and publishing usage may require a free allowance, trial, or paid subscription depending on your account plan.

What happens after I install from WordPress?

Open the RankOps AI menu in WordPress. The setup page gives you the Publish URL and Security key you need to connect this site from RankOps AI.

Does this plugin add backlinks or public credit links?

No. The plugin only receives approved articles for your WordPress site. It does not inject public credit links, badges, footer links, or backlinks.

What data does RankOps AI send to WordPress?

When you publish an article, RankOps AI sends the article title, slug, HTML body, excerpt or meta description, language, requested post status, categories, tags, and a RankOps article identifier used to avoid duplicate posts.

Can I choose the author, categories, and tags?

Yes. The plugin settings include a default author. RankOps AI can match existing WordPress categories and tags, and the plugin can create missing tags when you allow it.

Can I revoke access?

Yes. Open the RankOps AI menu in WordPress and revoke or rotate the Security key. Update the new key in RankOps AI before publishing again.

Does the plugin slow down visitor pages?

No. The plugin does not load frontend scripts for visitors. It runs when RankOps AI sends an article or when an administrator opens the plugin setup page.
